svg.title: A forest only helps as far as the trees disagree
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A forest only helps as far as the trees disagree” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Ten training rows resampled into three bootstrap bags where about a third of rows in each bag are drawn dashed and marked out-of-bag and others are marked drawn twice, feeding three visibly different trees into a circled AVERAGE, beside a table of max_features against tree correlation 0.53 to 0.68 and accuracy, the variance formula with the correlation term circled in red, and two importance bar charts where a pure-noise customer_id column takes 0.8182 of the in-sample impurity credit and zero of the held-out permutation credit.
svg.text: A forest only helps as far as the trees disagree
draw it from memory, then compare
